name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Simple live Cups for 2–8 racers: one track pick each, finalist scoring, smooth POV spectating, PB and record panels.
changelog: Center and strengthen the ranking heading; remove the points-target subtitle and increase separation from track records.
Center spectator controls at the bottom in a symmetric trapezoid, with separate mirrored previous/next buttons and visible bracket shortcuts.
Keep direct racer selection in the main name, with personal best, buffered time and speed beneath it.
